crossRefs.note: When the governor had read it, he asked what province he was from. When he understood that he was from Cilicia, he said,
“Let them therefore”, he said, “that are in power among you go down with me, and if there is anything wrong in the man…
When he had landed at Caesarea, he went up and greeted the assembly, and went down to Antioch.
After these days we took up our baggage and went up to Jerusalem.

people.name: Caesarea
people.line: Coastal city, center of Roman rule in Judea

people.name: Festus
people.line: Roman governor of Judea; heard Paul's case; sent him to Rome.

people.name: Jerusalem
people.line: The capital of Israel, a holy city for three religions

translations.web: Festus therefore, having come into the province, after three days went up to Jerusalem from Caesarea.
translations.bsb: Three days after his arrival in the province, Festus went up from Caesarea to Jerusalem,
translations.kjv: Now when Festus was come into the province, after three days he ascended from Caesarea to Jerusalem.
translations.asv: Festus therefore, having come into the province, after three days went up to Jerusalem from Caesarea.
